result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: Vendor covers third-party IP claims, breach of law, Vendor-caused unauthorized access or disclosure, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; Affiliates are protected; Customer's indemnity is confined to Customer content and legal violations; and standard procedures and IP remedies are included. The existing clauses are otherwise preserved. Drafting quality is reduced because the new indemnification provisions are unnumbered, while Section 9.3 continues to refer to remedies in Section 20.5, leaving an apparent broken cross-reference. The data trigger is also somewhat narrower than a general Vendor-caused data breach because it addresses only unauthorized access or disclosure.
